'''Paul Tartaglio''' (also published as '''Paul Tartagito''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 1st at [[June 2001 Eagle Rock tournament]] on 9 June 2001, according to Michael Mendoza's tournament report, which calls him one of the local Squadron Members.<ref name="tr-d2446">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 12 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ GitHub Pages].</ref> As Paul Tartagito he played at [[2001 Vegas DPC]] on 28 April 2001 with [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Base matching pilots]], according to Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2211">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-a-canadian-in-vegas-dpc-by-serpentd2211/ a-canadian-in-vegas-dpc-by-serpent], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 30 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-30-a-canadian-in-vegas-dpc-by-serpentd2211/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
